The '''Tetso system''' was a part of the [[Arrowhead]] region, in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Region" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Tetso Shopping Worlds]].<ref name="SWA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tetso [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-10.<ref name="EAOC" />
